job_profiles.title: Senior React Developer

requirements.education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

job_profiles.job_description: We are looking for a Senior React Developer to join our team. You will be responsible for building high-performance, modular, and visually stunning web applications. You will collaborate closely with designers and product managers to deliver top-tier user experiences. You must have deep expertise in React state management, performance optimization, and writing clean, scalable TypeScript.

job_profiles.title: AI/ML Engineer

requirements.education: Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, or equivalent technical background

job_profiles.job_description: We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer to build advanced agentic workflows and integrate Large Language Models into our business products. You will work on designing RAG pipelines, fine-tuning prompts, creating workflows, and optimizing AI agents for reliability and speed. Experience building workflows in tools like n8n or LangGraph is highly desired.

job_profiles.title: Technical Product Manager

requirements.education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field

job_profiles.job_description: We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to lead the roadmap and execution of our AI developer tools. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, writing comprehensive PRDs, running agile sprints, and defining key product metrics.
